fun_fact: Europe has spent the last couple of weeks battling severe wildfires across Spain, France, Portugal and Greece — and it is now bracing for its fourth heatwave of the season. It is no coincidence: Europe is the fastest-warming continent, heating at twice the global average, which dries out the land and turns each new heat spell into fresh fire risk.
